purpose: The brand block at the top of a Sidebar: a logo with a title and an optional subtitle, collapsing to the logo alone. Wrap it in a link to the home route.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Sidebar.
A logo and name in a page header or footer.

Collapsed=false.visual: Logo, title in Content/primary and the optional subtitle in Content/secondary.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable itself; the link around it is reached with Tab and followed with Enter.
notes: The link around it needs an accessible name equal to the title.

openQuestions: Motion: the Collapsed axis has no motion decision (finding MOT-002). Should the title fade when the rail folds?
